translations.web: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
translations.bsb: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
translations.kjv: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
